text:
devon: quick follow-up on TICKET-12345 — vendor said ~40 H100 slots would be released to our account today. I only see 8 in the console. Anyone else?

sachin: I saw the vendor slack earlier, they pushed to partner account, not our tenant yet. I opened a case with their ops.

devon: tag mismatch maybe — terraform project tag is inference-demo. booking shows tag 'rdw-demo' which won't map to our quota. Can procurement confirm tag mapping?

laura: checking with procurement now. @procurement-bot which purchase order was used for that rack?

procurement-bot: PO 789321 associated with vendor shipment #VE-4521. Invoice is pending matching. (reaction :eyes:)

maria: FYI CI loadtests scheduled for tonight 22:00 UTC — if we don't get the slots we'll run on small-slice and results will be noisy.

sachin: vendor case 84321 updated — they say tags propagate in their staging after a manual sync. ETA 3h. I'll ping again.

devon: can we request a temporary carve on our account as fallback? Example terraform snippet to bump quota:
```hcl
resource "cloud_quota_request" "temp_h100" {
  project = "redwood-inference-prod"
  region  = "us-west1"
  gpu     = "h100"
  count   = 24
  reason  = "temp demo + CI smoke until vendor tags propagate"
}
```

laura: that's fine from procurement. I'll approve a short-term carve (24h) if finance signs off. @eric could you OK a 24h charge?

eric: finance OK for a 24h emergency bump up to $6k. Please include cost center PROJECT-INFERENCE-DEV.

devon: thanks all. sachin please paste vendor case link here and I'll update CI playbook to fall back if still not available.

sachin: vendor case https://vendor.support/cases/84321 — they scheduled sync at 19:30 UTC. I'll add a note to the ticket when it's done.

devon: perfect. will update the test matrix and ping again if anything changes. :thumbsup:
